plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official UCSF General Catalog 'Doctor of Medicine (MD)' page, 'Foundations 1 Requirements by Course' Plan of Study Grid. The catalog page prints no catalog year; retrieval-year stamp applied. SCOPE (honest): the MD Bridges Curriculum is a 4-year, three-phase curriculum (Foundations 1, Foundations 2, Career Launch); the catalog publishes a term-by-term grid ONLY for the Foundations 1 phase (Year 1: 62 units, Year 2: 27 units, Total 89 - reconciles exactly). Foundations 2 and Career Launch requirements are published in WEEKS (clerkship blocks, CIExes, electives) with individualized scheduling, not a fixed term-by-term course sequence; they are NOT invented here. PREREQUISITES (stated explicitly in the catalog and encoded): 'the elements that comprise each course in F1 proceed in a longitudinal and developmental fashion, and students must complete them in order' and 'students must pass all eight F1 courses' to advance; the single entry point is INTERDEPT 121A. CATALOG TYPO (kept verbatim in effect): the principles text writes 'IDS 121A' for the entry point; the course is INTERDEPT 121A in the grid. UCSF runs on the QUARTER system; seeded as published (years), which the pipeline excludes from semester-based plans.
